tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: Browse or keyword-search the verified catalog of pay-per-call (x402) agent services. Use it when you don't know the task name or want to see what exists; use lookup to rank endpoints for a known task at a max price, and get_service for one id's full record. Read-only. No auth or API key; free, no qu

tools.name: get_service
tools.description: Fetch the complete catalog record for one known service id (e.g. from search_catalog or lookup results). Use search_catalog to find ids and lookup to rank services for a task; get_service has no per-call receipts, so for receipts with tx and Basescan links call lookup with endpoint=<id>. Read-only.

tools.name: lookup
tools.description: Rank x402 endpoints for a known task at or under a price: "which endpoint should I pay for task X at <= $Y?". Prefer it over search_catalog (keyword browsing, unranked) and get_service (one id's raw record). No auth or API key. Calls the hosted lookup service as client=vc-mcp; all MCP users share th

tools.name: get_overnight_cos_pack
tools.description: Buy and download the Overnight Chief of Staff Setup Pack ($9 USDC on Base via x402): 5 ready-to-paste bot prompts, an HTML morning-briefing template, and a PDF setup guide. Always paid — no free quota. Call without PAYMENT-SIGNATURE to receive payment requirements and the HTTP endpoint URL. Agents p

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Free: read a public 402xAgent receipt. Give id (sc-... from endpoint_spot_check's receipt_id, or a 10-hex crawl id) or url (latest live + crawl receipt for that URL). Receipts hold the listing URL, the live 402 terms, verdict, reason, reason_code, confidence, history summary, timestamp, and a status

tools.name: endpoint_spot_check
tools.description: Decision-shaped 402xAgent check of a public URL (private, loopback and link-local addresses blocked on every redirect hop) for an x402 PAYMENT-REQUIRED / 402 challenge. Every answer has reason_code (stable code) and confidence (high|medium|low); rules: https://402xagent.com/rules.json. History: stab

tools.name: payment_status
tools.description: After you pay an x402 endpoint (Base USDC, EIP-3009 exact): did the payment land, and is it safe to sign a new one? Give payment_payload (the base64 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE you sent), or tx_hash, or from + nonce (+ valid_before). Returns status landed|not_landed|pending|canceled|unknown, safe_to_retry_sam

tools.name: x402_hygiene
tools.description: Free x402 hygiene score for an endpoint you run: {score, grade, deductions[{code, points, fix}]} from normal unpaid requests (never pays, never sends bad params). 20 per day per network, cached 24 h. Grades are returned only to you.

tools.name: discover
tools.description: Free discovery of x402 pay-per-call endpoints from 402xAgent's weekly crawl. Returns up to 20 endpoints matching the words in q (URL or source list), each with the verified (quoted) price, network, last_checked, stale flag, verdict pay|skip|recheck with its reason, and a receipt. Skips are included

tools.name: endpoint_report
tools.description: Paid ($0.05 USDC on Base via x402, no free tier): the exact committed snapshots behind endpoint_spot_check's locked teasers: which payment terms changed in the last 30 days, when, from what to what, and the full hygiene checks. Pass the url and the commitment_ref from the free answer's locked_commit

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_overnight_cos_pack, get_receipt, endpoint_spot_check, discover · Private data: search_catalog, get_service, lookup, endpoint_spot_check · Public sink: lookup, endpoint_spot_check, payment_status · Destructive: lookup, get_receipt, endpoint_spot_check, x402_hygiene, discover.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_overnight_cos_pack, get_receipt, endpoint_spot_check, discover · Private data: search_catalog, get_service, lookup, endpoint_spot_check · Public sink: lookup, endpoint_spot_check, payment_status · Destructive: lookup, get_receipt, endpoint_spot_check, x402_hygiene, discover

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_catalog" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
